WITH q AS (
WITH a AS (
  SELECT t, value FROM prom_agg('sum', 'irate', ('pgwatch_archive_lag_archived_count'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}]]),

), b AS (
  SELECT t, value FROM prom_agg('sum', 'irate', ('pgwatch_archive_lag_failed_count'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}]]),
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) ELSE greatest(${__interval_ms} + 5000, 20000) END AS BIGINT)))

WITH q AS (
SELECT labels, t, value
FROM prom_topk((10::BIGINT), ('irate'), ('pgwatch_pg_stat_statements_wal_bytes'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}], ['datname', '=~', '${db_name:regex}']]),
       (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) ELSE greatest(${__interval_ms} + 5000, 20000) END AS BIGINT)),
       p_by := CAST((['queryid']) AS VARCHAR[]))
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'queryid ' || coalesce(q.labels['queryid'], '') AS series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
